title: How Ancient Indians Broke a Mountain with Fire and Water
description:
Before ancient builders could carve a single statue of Shiva, they had to remove 400,000 tons of the hardest rock on Earth.

When iron chisels shattered against 140 MPa tholeiitic basalt, master architect Kokasa deployed an ancient weapon recorded in the Shilpa Shastras: Agni-Karma—the science of thermal shock.

This is Episode 2 of our 10-part documentary web-series on the construction of the Kailasa Temple (Ellora Cave 16).
